problem_text: Can MVFA's few-shot inference be made inductive, scoring each image only with statistics of the K normal support images and source-validation data instead of test-set min-max normalisation, while keeping image AUROC within 1 point of the re-run transductive baseline and making each image's score invariant to the composition of the rest of the test set (prevalence 10-50%, with and without outliers)? The replacement is evaluated component by component (normalisation, then fusion weight, then image-level aggregation), with sensitivity at 95% specificity and expected calibration error reported alongside AUROC.

ranking.title: Cauchy-combined level-wise conformal few-shot evidence fused in log-odds with a temperature-calibrated zero-shot branch

Novelty.review: Layer-wise multiple-testing fusion of conformal p-values exists for OOD detection; combining level-wise few-shot p-values with a temperature-calibrated zero-shot probability for MVFA is new.

Clarity.review: Combination rule and fusion specified; episode settings could be fixed more precisely.

Impact.review: Makes MVFA deployable per image with an error guarantee for the few-shot test.

Validity.review: Valid under dependence between levels; exchangeability of supports and test normals is assumed.
